page.overview:
What is Skirmish in the Anoat sector?

Shortly after the Battle of Endor in 4 ABY, Imperial Moff Ubrik Adelhard, commanding his flagship Imperial-class Star Destroyer Scepter, engaged in a skirmish with Rebel Alliance Navy forces that had entered the Anoat sector. After managing to disable the Alliance to Restore the Republic Starfighters, the Imperial naval forces, on the order of Adelhard, destroyed all rebel starships, leaving no survivors.
